maria: Quick sync — we're doing a snapshot/sweep for token-cost attribution tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need schema freeze, owners, and CRs in. Who's on point for schema and samples?
aj: I'll own the schema freeze and sample set. Aim to freeze by EOD today. Any blockers?
maria: If freeze misses EOD we'll run the sweep on v1 and plan a v2 backfill. @kevin can you confirm ingestion compatibility for v2 mapping?
kevin: Ingestion path is compatible with a mapping layer, but I need to add a small migration map and a smoke script. I'll open a PR in ~30m. :+1:
sam: I'll take canary & smoke test runs. Need the sample queries + expected token counts to validate cost regressions. @aj can you drop them?
aj: Dropping a sample bundle now. Sample format in thread below.
aj: ```
# sample event (newline separated)
{"user_id":"u123","prompt":"summarize: sales Q1","tokens_expected":42}
{"user_id":"u456","prompt":"embed: product description","tokens_expected":18}
```
telemetry-bot: job scheduled: instr-snapshot-sweep-2026-03-18T16:00Z (id: job-8812). status: pending.
maria: Also need a rollback owner if token cost spikes after sweep. Threshold proposal: 20% above baseline triggers rollback. @elaine?
elaine: I'll be rollback owner. If cost > 20% I'll flip traffic to the small-model pool and notify infra.
kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/instr/pull/345 — migration map + ingestion smoke script included.
sam: noted, will wait for merge then run smoke tests. ETA ~2h after merge. @aj ping when samples land in S3.
aj: samples uploaded to s3://redwood-instr/samples/2026-03-18 — README includes expected token counts and pass criteria.
maria: Checklist: schema freeze (aj) ✅, PR open (kevin) ✅, samples uploaded (aj) ✅, canary + smoke (sam) in ~2h. Tagging owners: @maria @aj @kevin @sam @elaine :eyes:
kevin: ack.
